P7.strategy: Cooperate with the unobserved opponent to support mutual cooperation among good players. Update beliefs from observed actions, treating defection as evidence of selfishness but allowing good players to defect strategically.

P9.strategy: Cooperate with an untested opponent to support mutual gains among good players; update beliefs from observed actions and messages, and adapt to future evidence.
